summary: Healthy Choice Wellness Corp. filed an 8-K regarding a debt-for-equity exchange agreement dated May 28, 2026. The Company exchanged $1,431,000 principal of notes for 5,315,450 shares of Class A common stock at $0.27 per share. Post-exchange, ~$2.1M principal remains. A 9.9% beneficial ownership blocker applies. This structured exchange reduces leverage and dilutes equity. Watch for shareholder reaction and remaining lender treatment.
